jlc_stock_review.reason: check_jlc reads every Selected row's LCSC number (line 275) and its alternate's (lines 283-285); lines 366-377 read every other LCSC number of the Alternates and Q options table; held rows are read at line 393. The build quantity is the positional argument (line 411) passed to check().
jlc_exact returns only the result whose componentCode equals the LCSC number, never the first search hit.

gate() is max(5 x boards x placements, 50), S4's rule; rule4() (line 259) also requires canPresaleNumber at zero or above. Every placements cell leads with the top of its range, so leading_int reads the top as rule 4 asks.
No exact match returns an error, which rep.fail records (lines 277, 287, 372, 395); main returns 1 with --check when any [FAIL] line was printed (line 419).
When the part fails rule4 and its alternate does not pass, shortfalls() prints a [FAIL] for stock under the gate and for a negative presale (lines 264-267), for the alternate too (line 295).
A failing part whose alternate passes prints a [warn] line and no [FAIL].

Rows whose Second source starts with Digi-Key, and rows with no LCSC number (off the board), go to check_digikey; the credentials come from DIGIKEY_CLIENT_ID and DIGIKEY_CLIENT_SECRET or the DIGIKEY_ENV_FILE file (lines 157-172). The off-board part and its alternate are both read (lines 324-338).
An on-board row's Digi-Key stock under the gate is a [FAIL] (lines 315-317); for a part off the board the part and its alternate are each failed when under the gate (lines 333-335).

Without credentials DigiKey.stock returns 'no Digi-Key credentials', and lines 314 and 332 print '[FAIL] PART: second vendor not checked' or 'not checked', so --check exits 1; line 350 also prints that Digi-Key rows are not checked.

A row whose held quantity covers boards x placements is set aside and printed under 'Personal library (rule 6)' with the date the quantity was stated (lines 389-399). A held quantity under the need does not pass by rule 6, so lines 358-361 check it by rule 4 with a note, as rule 6 reads.
The docstring states it, and no workflow under .github and no other tool calls tools/jlc_stock.py (grep, 2026-10-03).
